Line: A cup for me too? I nearly forgot to ask.
Leave the last seat open. I'll sit with you.
A bigger kettle. Someone else can pour the first cup.
A little help carrying the flame. Thank you.
Your spark, my shell. We take turns.
More room for the names I carried through the flood.
Useful delivery. Nobody's name hidden in the bill.
One route, several addresses. We'll visit them all.
More room in the bag. The unopened letters stay unopened.
Something for the road, and an ordinary rest afterward.
I can close one eye if you keep the other watch.
A little stronger. Still allowed to need sleep.
That deserves a footnote in our favour.
Different accounts, kept on the same shelf.
A wider shelf. No missing reader gets written over.
I'll keep your left side covered. You choose the road.
You came back by choice. I remember that much.
A wider hood. An open way out for everyone.
That should steady the wobble in my salute.
Same ferry. Nobody has to prove they deserve a crossing.
A firmer stance. The last lesson is still lowering the sword.
A useful purchase. Put no crown on the receipt.
Every root gets a say in where we grow.
Bigger branches. Plenty of room for the next leader.
Good. We can save a little strength for breakfast.
Ring once for each neighbour. I hear them coming.
A stronger shell for carrying the breakfast bell.
A quieter whistle already. Let me check the passage.
I hear your answer. I'll ask before I follow.
A deeper whistle. I still check where the echo comes from.
I'll mark this page. We did something kind here.
Your place is kept. You can go and come back.
More pages, and a life beyond the reserved chapter.
Time well spent. I checked the hands myself.
That bell is for a real arrival. Ours.
A louder bell. Only for things I've really seen.
A little help for the crossing. My friend would approve.
Hold the rail. I'll test the next step.
A longer hop. Still my choice when to take it.
A better fit. Keep the old stitch where I can see it.
I know those repairs. You've looked after somebody too.
Larger buttons. I kept the little coat's old repair.
That belongs in the column marked help, not debt.
Several witnesses. One honest record.
A heavier ledger. Nobody's name becomes a charge.
A little less cold to carry with us.
Take the warm side. I'll mind the frost.
A broader bowl. We can share the thaw.
Something useful, with room to change our minds.
Our lessons can disagree and still belong together.
Wider wings. No rule says we must fly the same way.
Good. Save your strength for getting home.
You can lean here without winning anything first.
A little sturdier. I can put the old title down.
That might help us reach the next open window.
Tell them about the outside. I'll keep the light in sight.
Stronger wings. I'd like to show my family a real sunrise.
A sensible purchase. I'll save the joke for later.
You listened all the way through. I'll do the same.
A bigger voice. It needn't be funny to be heard.
For once, a good surprise without a punchline.
Hear that? Nobody had to laugh to let us stay.
I can stand a little taller without hiding in the joke.
That leaves a little more strength for planting.
Different seeds can share the same ground.
More room for the seeds. The lost ones still have their names.
A little help holding the shape I chose.
Your tide meets mine. Neither has to swallow the other.
A wider tide. I'll leave the shore where you can reach it.
A useful thing. I'll try not to lose its other half.
Mismatched is fine. We can still walk together.
Bigger steps. Same mismatched pair.
Good. A little more room before the string goes tight.
Hold loosely. I'm staying because I want to.
A longer tail. The string still comes back to my hands.
Something for the journey, whoever I become.
You don't need to know what hatches to make room for me.
A stronger shell. I'll choose when it opens.
I can mind the dark a little longer with that.
We can share a light without circling it forever.
Wider wings. I can fly straight and still choose your company.
The needle likes a plan with help in it.
Several roads, and permission to choose one.
A steadier needle. Home still gets more than one direction.
Good. The letters should reach their doors dry.
Same rain. I'll shelter your letter beside mine.
A roomier shell. The thank-you travels safely.
A small improvement. Let's keep the real sea in mind.
I can hear you over the broadcast now.
A clearer voice. One day I'll listen without the static.
A little help breathing easily. I'll save you a breath.
Stay beside me. Nobody has to hold their breath alone.
A deeper breath. There will still be room in the pond.
That should make the weight a little kinder.
Take the other end. We can set it down together.
A stronger shell. Carrying it needn't be my whole life.
Good supplies. Now let's find a wind we can trust.
Several hands on the sail. Every hand can let go.
A fuller sail. This time we choose the harbour.
One eye on the purchase, one hope for the road.
I can watch your back if you watch the doorway.
A bigger stride. I'll still look back for you.
I'd call that a fair roll. No seventh side involved.
Whatever comes up, we share the table.
A sturdier pair of claws. The crooked die stays with me.
Good. Perhaps I can loosen the mask a little.
You made room before I put on the brave face.
Stronger legs. The mask can come off when I'm ready.
I'll draw that beside the door we're finding.
We can colour outside the same old lines.
A broader stroke. Nobody else's picture gets rubbed out.
That looks useful from this side of the glass too.
I see real company. The reflection can catch up.
A clearer outline. The face looking back is still mine.
A helpful thread. No knot around anybody's wrist.
Hold this end if you want to. I'll hold mine.
A wider weave. Every thread still has a loose end.
A careful bargain. Let it simmer, then we go.
Room by the kettle for every tired traveller.
A bigger kettle. We don't have to boil the same night again.
A little help for careful hands. Thank you.
Pass me the loose edge. We'll mend it without pulling.
A stronger seam. I kept the old stitches too.
Hold that thought. This frame is worth keeping.
Everyone fits. Nobody has to stand behind the camera.
A wider frame. I can keep us all in the picture.
A useful pattern. Leave room for the wearer to choose.
Different colours. No one is sewn into their place.
More cloth for pockets we can fill with ordinary days.
A gentle note for the road. No marching orders.
Follow if you wish. The ringing isn't a command.
A fuller bell. There is room for a quieter answer.
You thought of me while looking at that shelf.
You made space without asking me to be repaired first.
A bigger patchwork. I was already worth coming back for.
That should keep the thank-you safe a little longer.
No address missing now. We know where to find each other.
A wider fold. The letter inside is still unopened.
A little help before I go back to sleep.
I'll rest easier knowing you have one another.
A softer place to land when the visit is over.
Useful parts. I'll leave the release where you can reach it.
A working hinge needs room to open both ways.
Steadier hands. Every lock still gets its own spare key.
Good. A little more breath for the unfinished tune.
Keep your own tempo. I'll listen for where we meet.
A fuller sound. I kept the missing verse's place.
Something useful, without another title to defend.
The quiet ones count too. I wrote them in myself.
Stronger. You can still call me without the title.
A useful addition. Tell me if it doesn't fit.
Several hands on the plan. Anyone may ask for a revision.
A sturdier fold. Every shelter still gets an opening.
Good provisions. We won't call another circle an arrival.
Same deck. Every passenger keeps a say in the destination.
A stronger tiller. This return will be our choice.
That's help we can use. Save a portion for the cooks.
Everyone at the table. Nobody eats after their shift forever.
Stronger hands. The first loaf still belongs to the people who made it.
A little help for the journey. I'll choose the next stop.
All aboard by choice. The doors open at every stop.
A stronger engine. I'd like to visit somewhere new.
That helps the person here, not just the memory.
You remembered my name and asked what I wanted next.
A clearer outline. I have more to become than evidence.
A useful thing. I'll ask again when the spell has faded.
You can change your mind. I'll still hear you.
A steadier voice. An answer given freely carries further.
That leaves a little more shelter for young leaves.
Several roots, and more than one open gate.
Wider leaves. I won't choose where the little ones settle.
Something helpful. Perhaps my spines can relax a little.
Close is all right. Someone else is keeping watch.
A bigger shape. Still practising how to be gentle.
I can use that to open a route I once closed.
You can walk beside me without saying I've been forgiven.
I don't merge. I'll keep making my own next choice.
A little help. The valve stays in my hands.
Rescue crew together. Nobody charges rent for air.
More room to breathe. I still choose how much air I carry.
Will that help us find a window with real rain?
I can grow this way? You can grow another way too.
We grew. Please let us choose where the new roots go.
A useful thing. Please put my name on the traveller list.
Company, not cargo. I like this arrangement.
Rounder, perhaps. Still a traveller with my own destination.
Good supplies. Ask before you climb aboard.
I'll carry whoever asks. We choose the road together.
A stronger back. No more circles unless we want them.
I'll try a note with that. Leave room for an answer.
Different notes. We can still make a tune together.
A fuller song. The quiet between notes belongs there too.
A little help for the current. I'll mind the loose ribbon.
Hold on lightly. We can swim beside one another.
A stronger stroke. I'll leave the river room to turn.
A helpful thread. I'll keep both ends within reach.
A path that can survive an honest goodbye. That's our work.
A longer thread. I still teach people how to let it go.
